en.title: Featured Speakers
en.summary: Curated founders, investors, operators, and public-sector leaders for conferences, missions, roundtables, and executive briefings.
en.imageAlt: Speaker presenting to a business audience.
en.metaDescription: Request featured speakers for China-LATAM technology events, delegations, and executive briefings.
en.bodyHtml:
LATAM China Tech curates speakers who can translate cross-border technology, investment, and market-entry experience into practical insight for flagship stages and private rooms.

Each speaker shortlist is built around the audience, sector, market, and decision context of the event.

sections.title: Operator and founder voices
sections.bodyHtml: Bring founders, executives, investors, and ecosystem builders who can speak from direct China-LATAM execution experience.

sections.title: Stage and panel design
sections.bodyHtml: We help shape keynote, panel, roundtable, and mission-session formats so speakers are matched to the right audience and outcome.

sections.title: Private executive briefings
sections.bodyHtml: For investors, cities, corporates, and delegations, we organize smaller expert briefings with high-context market and sector perspectives.

br.title: Speakers em destaque
br.summary: Founders, investidores, operadores e liderancas publicas curados para conferencias, missoes, roundtables e briefings executivos.
br.imageAlt: Speaker apresentando para uma audiencia de negocios.
br.metaTitle: Speakers em destaque | LATAM China Tech
br.metaDescription: Solicite speakers para eventos, delegacoes e briefings executivos de tecnologia China-LATAM.
br.bodyHtml:
A LATAM China Tech cura speakers que traduzem experiencia em tecnologia, investimento e entrada em mercado cross-border em insights praticos para grandes palcos e salas privadas.

Cada shortlist e montada a partir do publico, setor, mercado e contexto de decisao do evento.

sections.title: Vozes de operadores e founders
sections.bodyHtml: Leve founders, executivos, investidores e construtores de ecossistema que falam a partir de experiencia real entre China e LATAM.

sections.title: Desenho de palco e paineis
sections.bodyHtml: Ajudamos a desenhar keynotes, paineis, roundtables e sessoes de missao para combinar speakers com o publico e o resultado certo.

sections.title: Briefings executivos privados
sections.bodyHtml: Para investidores, cidades, corporates e delegacoes, organizamos briefings menores com especialistas e alto contexto de mercado e setor.

cn.title: 精选演讲嘉宾
cn.summary: 为会议、商务考察、圆桌和高管简报策划创始人、投资人、运营者和公共部门负责人。
cn.imageAlt: 演讲嘉宾正在向商务观众演讲。
cn.metaTitle: 精选演讲嘉宾 | LATAM China Tech
cn.metaDescription: 为中国-拉美科技活动、代表团和高管简报申请精选演讲嘉宾。
cn.bodyHtml:
LATAM China Tech 策划能够把跨境科技、投资和市场进入经验转化为实用洞察的演讲嘉宾，适用于旗舰舞台和私密交流场景。

每一份嘉宾名单都会围绕活动受众、行业、市场和决策语境设计。

sections.title: 运营者与创始人声音
sections.bodyHtml: 邀请创始人、高管、投资人和生态建设者，分享真实的中国-拉美执行经验。

sections.title: 舞台与圆桌设计
sections.bodyHtml: 我们协助设计主题演讲、圆桌、闭门会和商务考察环节，让嘉宾与受众及目标更匹配。

sections.title: 高管闭门简报
sections.bodyHtml: 面向投资人、城市、企业和代表团，我们组织小范围专家简报，提供高语境的市场和行业视角。
